Pro tip: the Wolf Den is designed so there isn't a bad seat in the house, but getting there a few minutes before a set starts helps if you want to be right against the stage. If you'd prefer to walk off dinner first, the Shops at Mohegan Sun are open until 9:00 PM tonight for some retail therapy.
